## Overview

The Page call records when a user sees a page, along with optional properties about that page. In `analytics.js`, a Page call is included in the snippet by default after `analytics.load`.

## Core Fields

| Field      | Type   | Required | Description |
|-----------|--------|----------|-------------|
| `category` | String | optional | Category of the page; passed as first argument, e.g. `analytics.page("category", "name")` |
| `name`     | String | optional | Name of the page (e.g., "Signup", "Home") |
| `properties` | Object | optional | Free-form dict of page properties like `url`, `referrer`, `title`, `path` |

## JavaScript Example

```js
analytics.page("Retail Page", "Home");
```

## Payload Example

```json
{
  "anonymousId": "507f191e810c19729de860ea",
  "channel": "browser",
  "context": {
    "ip": "8.8.8.8",
    "userAgent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_9_5) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/40.0.2214.115 Safari/537.36"
  },
  "integrations": {
    "All": true,
    "Mixpanel": false,
    "Salesforce": false
  },
  "messageId": "022bb90c-bbac-11e4-8dfc-aa07a5b093db",
  "name": "Home",
  "properties": {
    "title": "Welcome | Initech",
    "url": "http://www.example.com"
  },
  "receivedAt": "2015-02-23T22:28:55.387Z",
  "sentAt": "2015-02-23T22:28:55.111Z",
  "timestamp": "2015-02-23T22:28:55.111Z",
  "type": "page",
  "userId": "97980cfea0067",
  "version": "1.1"
}
```

## Reserved Properties

Use reserved properties ONLY for their intended meaning:

| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `name` | String | Name of the page. Reserved for future use. |
| `path` | String | Path portion of the page's URL (e.g., `location.pathname`). |
| `referrer` | String | Previous page's full URL (`document.referrer`). |
| `search` | String | Query string portion of the page's URL (`location.search`). |
| `title` | String | Page title (`document.title`). |
| `url` | String | Page's full URL. Segment uses canonical URL if available, else `location.href`. |
| `keywords` | Array[String] | List of keywords describing page content (for content publishers; not auto-collected). |

## Auto-Population

In Analytics.js, these properties are **automatically collected and sent**: `title`, `path`, `url`, `referrer`, `search`.

User ID is **automatically added** from the state stored by a previous `identify()` call. Anonymous ID is also handled automatically by browser and mobile libraries.

## Identity Fields

- **`userId`** — unique identifier for the user (see [User ID docs](https://www.twilio.com/docs/segment/connections/spec/identify#user-id))
- **`anonymousId`** — pseudo-unique identifier when user identity is unknown (see [Anonymous ID docs](https://www.twilio.com/docs/segment/connections/spec/identify#anonymous-id))
